propositions: Plan-review Pass-2 verification rejects every finding index as unexpected when Pass-1 yields zero findings, degrading all findings to INDETERMINATE
The verify kernel sends an empty index domain to the model for zero-finding batches, but the model returns indices 0..N-1, causing a reshape contract violation
verify_instructions() returns an instruction imperative to emit verifications when given an empty batch, creating an unsatisfiable contract that the model answers with invented indices
INDETERMINATE findings cannot trigger a BLOCK decision and are silently absorbed if any advisory surfaces, so the gate passes unverified rather than failing
The fix changes verify_instructions() to return EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS for empty batches, eliminating the contract violation on the zero-finding path
